user.title: Mitsubishi AE-200 / EW-50
user.description: Enter the IP address of your AE-200, AE-50, EW-50 or compatible centralised controller. The controller must be reachable on your network.

data.prefer_websocket: Prefer websocket (gives zone names; recommended for AE-200/EW-50)

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the controller. Check the IP address and that the controller's web interface is reachable.
error.no_groups: Connected, but no air-conditioning groups were found on the controller.

read_today_schedule.name: Read today's schedule
read_today_schedule.description: Read today's controller schedule for one configured group on demand. Returns a snapshot, including an empty schedule, without predicting the next execution. Reads share a minimum 15 second interval.

config_entry_id.name: Controller
config_entry_id.description: The AE-200 configuration entry to read from. Select it explicitly even when only one controller is configured.

group_id.name: Group number
group_id.description: One configured group number from 1 to 50 on the selected controller.

read_control_context.name: Read control context
read_control_context.description: Read the controller and selected group's stop context on demand without changing settings. Each part reports its own data quality. Reads share a minimum 15 second interval.

config_entry_id.name: Controller
config_entry_id.description: The AE-200 configuration entry to read from. Select it explicitly even when only one controller is configured.

group_id.name: Group number
group_id.description: One configured group number from 1 to 50 on the selected controller.

read_member.name: Read indoor unit member
read_member.description: Read one indoor unit address verified by this controller's cached topology and return its diagnostic sample. Member reads share a minimum 15 second interval and are never polled automatically.

config_entry_id.name: Controller
config_entry_id.description: The AE-200 configuration entry to read from. Select it explicitly even when only one controller is configured.

address.name: Member address
address.description: One indoor unit bus address from 1 to 250, verified by the cached controller topology. This is not a group number or an IP address.
